title: Import & export (CSV)
intro: The files are made for Excel with German settings: UTF-8 with BOM, semicolon as delimiter, decimal comma. Anyone feeding another program chooses the comma as delimiter (then with a decimal point). The import reads both notations.
importHint: Every import first checks without writing anything (dry run) and shows the errors per row. Only “Apply” writes, in one transaction and through the normal rules (stock only as a booking in the ledger). Sensible order: articles, then stock, then orders. Sample files are in the project under docs/samples/.

articles.label: Articles
articles.description: Creates articles or changes existing ones (per SKU). Running the same import twice changes nothing. If a column is missing in the file, the field stays unchanged.
articles.required: Sku; for new articles also Name, LengthMm, WidthMm, HeightMm

stock.label: Stock
stock.description: Sets the stock per article, location and lot to the value in the file. The difference is booked and appears in the ledger (operation “CsvImport”).
stock.required: Sku, Location (storage location), Quantity; optional LotNumber, ExpiryDate

orders.label: Orders
orders.description: Creates new orders (one row per line). An existing order number is an error; existing orders are never changed.
orders.required: OrderNumber, Sku, Quantity; optional CustomerReference, Priority, DueDate, ExternalReference

articles.label: Articles
articles.description: The article master data, importable again (same structure as the article import).

stock.label: Stock
stock.description: One row per article, location and lot with quantity and expiry date.

orders.label: Orders
orders.description: One row per order line; the order header data repeats.

audit.label: Audit
audit.description: The audit trail, oldest entries first.

blocked.noneFree: No row is free of errors: there is nothing to apply.
blocked.nothing: There is nothing to apply: everything is already like this in the database.
blocked.rowErrors: There are row errors: correct the file or skip the faulty rows.

dialog.title: Import {{label}}
dialog.requiredColumns: Required columns: {{columns}}. Columns are recognised by their name; the order does not matter.
dialog.delimiterSemicolon: Semicolon (;), Excel default with decimal comma
dialog.tooBig: The file is {{size}}, larger than allowed ({{max}}). Please split it into several files.

preview.caption: Row errors
preview.truncated: The first {{shown}} of {{total}} errors are shown.
preview.skip: Skip faulty rows and apply the remaining {{num}}
